Only continued frozen confirmation avoids post-hoc source selection.
approval_ready_proposal.8_expected_upside: Determine whether MU can add meaningful bidirectional opportunity without assigning capital before the executable data-source contract is proven.
approval_ready_proposal.9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: Transport-dependent entries, sparse short evidence, historical observer gaps, unresolved mark intervals, winner concentration, fee and funding error, and accidental source relabeling.
approval_ready_proposal.10_validation_completed: Exact path, candle, strategy-signal, and observer-transport audits; report-only authority; side counts; nominal and stress lifecycle evidence from prior immutable replay; and telemetry-count correction separating missing rows from true mismatches.
approval_ready_proposal.11_validation_still_required: A predeclared contiguous forward parity window, more technically resolved both-side lifecycles, exact costs and exits, positive stress economics after largest-winner removal, and incremental portfolio-value analysis.
approval_ready_proposal.12_success_metrics: Zero entry mismatches and zero missing observer decisions in the predeclared confirmation window; at least 20 independent resolved lifecycles with both sides represented; positive stress net excluding the largest winner; no synthetic path substitution.
approval_ready_proposal.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any identity mismatch, observer gap, entry disagreement, unresolved risk path, negative robust after-cost result, or one-sided/winner-dependent evidence keeps MU out of live. No live rollback exists because authority remains none.
approval_ready_proposal.14_confidence_level: High confidence in the refreshed telemetry and source mismatch diagnosis; low confidence that MU currently has deployable edge; medium confidence that another contiguous parity window can resolve the transport question.
